title: The Rigidity of the closed three dimensional regular Landsberg metrics
summary: The Landsberg Berwald conjecture asks whether every regular Landsberg metric is Berwald. We settle this conjecture for closed three-dimensional manifolds: every smooth strongly convex regular Landsberg metric on such a manifold is Berwald, without any reversibility assumption.
